```{r}
#| label: setup
#| output: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
# Load the project's functions from the checkout (decision 0042) and read the
# published data bundle, so this code reproduces the figure (decision 0040).
root <- Sys.getenv("CFB2NFL_ROOT")
if (!nzchar(root)) root <- pkgload::pkg_path()
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = root)
pkgload::load_all(root, quiet = TRUE)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggiraph)

con <- DBI::dbConnect(
  duckdb::duckdb(),
  file.path(root, "data", "cfb2nfl.duckdb"),
  read_only = TRUE
)
release <- data_release_date()
ps <- collect(tbl(con, "ps_change"))
DBI::dbDisconnect(con, shutdown = TRUE)
# The current college season is still being played, so its partial stat lines
# are left out of the shares (decision 0053 and the card rules).
through <- last_complete_cfb_season()
ev <- transfer_events(ps) |>
  filter(season <= through, group != "Position not recorded")
```

```{r}
#| label: figure
# Each position group's transfers that moved to a lower tier. Quarterbacks and
# running backs are highlighted because they are the question's answer.
down_tab <- ev |>
  group_by(group) |>
  summarise(
    transfers = n(),
    down = sum(direction == "To a lower tier"),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    down_share = down / transfers,
    tip = sprintf(
      "%s: %.1f%% of %s transfers moved to a lower tier",
      group,
      100 * down_share,
      formatC(transfers, big.mark = ",", format = "d")
    ),
    label = sprintf(
      "%.1f%% of %s",
      100 * down_share,
      formatC(transfers, big.mark = ",", format = "d")
    ),
    highlight = group %in% c("Quarterback", "Running back")
  )

p <- ggplot(down_tab, aes(100 * down_share, reorder(group, down_share))) +
  geom_col_interactive(
    aes(fill = highlight, tooltip = tip, data_id = as.character(group)),
    width = 0.7
  ) +
  geom_text(aes(label = label), hjust = -0.05, size = 4.2) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "#D95F02", `FALSE` = "gray65")) +
  guides(fill = "none") +
  expand_limits(x = 60) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = function(x) sprintf("%.0f%%", x)) +
  labs(
    title = "Transfers to a lower tier by position",
    subtitle = "Share of each position group's transfers; orange: quarterback and running back",
    x = "Transfers to a lower tier",
    y = NULL,
    caption = card_caption(release)
  ) +
  theme_card()

card_thumbnail(p, "transfer-direction-by-position", release = release)
card_interactive(p)
```

```{r}
#| label: full-mix
# Each group's full direction mix, so the reader can see what the down share
# replaces: the rest of a group's moves were up or sideways.
mix <- ev |>
  count(group, direction, name = "moves") |>
  group_by(group) |>
  mutate(
    mix_share = moves / sum(moves),
    group = factor(group, levels = levels(reorder(down_tab$group, down_tab$down_share)))
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(
    move = case_when(
      direction == "To a higher tier" ~ "up",
      direction == "Same tier" ~ "same",
      TRUE ~ "down"
    ),
    move = factor(move, levels = c("down", "same", "up")),
    tip = sprintf(
      "%s, %s: %.1f%% (%s transfers)",
      group,
      tolower(as.character(direction)),
      100 * mix_share,
      formatC(moves, big.mark = ",", format = "d")
    )
  )

p_mix <- ggplot(mix, aes(100 * mix_share, group, fill = move)) +
  geom_col_interactive(
    aes(tooltip = tip, data_id = paste(group, move)),
    width = 0.7
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(up = "#1D4ED8", same = "#374151", down = "#9CA3AF"),
    labels = c(up = "To a higher tier", same = "Same tier", down = "To a lower tier"),
    breaks = c("down", "same", "up")
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = function(x) sprintf("%.0f%%", x)) +
  labs(
    title = "Every position's full direction mix",
    subtitle = "Share of each position group's transfers by direction",
    x = "Share of the group's transfers",
    y = NULL,
    fill = NULL,
    caption = "Hover a segment for the count."
  ) +
  theme_card()
card_interactive(p_mix)
```
